headline: Hansoh and GSK Bone Cancer Drug Trial Extends Patient Survival
summary: A clinical study shows that a joint cancer drug developed by Hansoh Pharmaceutical and GSK successfully extended survival rates in patients with bone cancer.
why: GSK is a major global pharmaceutical company, and successful late-stage clinical trials are vital for its product pipeline and future revenue.

impacts.name: GSK plc
impacts.why: Positive clinical trial results for oncology drugs strengthen a pharmaceutical company's future product pipeline and commercial potential.
